title: Wrappers feed codex exec witnesses into the landing's TOOL tier
description:
Split from task-7cc959e9b42043ba8009cdd9813103e0 (architect-e4b7eee0, 2026-10-30). This is the second slice.

Dependencies:
- task-4b0609d1e037417aa2c68e15d039b2d9: prompt-cache-witness.mjs, the helper that writes the witnesses.
- task-9d27749421b045c18a6c6eb99694236d: changes the same four wrapper and harness files, plus the remedy clauses this task rewords.
task-7cc959e9 lands after this one and flips the daemon text and docs.

Objective. A `codex exec` seat's successful apply_patch or Serena edit witnesses its path in the landing's TOOL set. A contested own path it edited then lands under skip-untouched, just as a one-shot Claude seat's does.

Deliverable:
1. scripts/moe-agent.sh. The codex exec pipeline (~7875, `... exec --json ... | node prompt-cache.mjs codex-stream`) runs the helper with the same env the Claude stream parser gets (~8505): MOE_TOOL_WRITES_FILE="$MOE_TOOL_WRITES_FILE" MOE_GIT_TOP="$MOE_TOP" MOE_GIT_REL="$MOE_REL" MOE_SERENA_PROJECT_ROOT="${SERENA_PROJECT:-$PROJECT}". The codex TUI branch is unchanged.
2. scripts/moe-agent.ps1. The codex exec ProcessStartInfo (~7041) gets a per-run temp witness file plus the same four env vars, through $psi.Environment.
- After WaitForExit, read the file as UTF-8 and merge each line with $script:MoeToolWritten[(Get-MoePathKey $p)] = $p, as Complete-MoeToolWrite does (~5497). Then delete the file.
- A missing or unreadable file merges nothing. Error handling: nothing may throw out of the pipeline's -End block.
- Find the ps1 values for TOP, REL and the Serena root at that point.
3. Make the held= remedy count codex exec sessions: attr_held_list and Get-MoeHeldList, as task-9d277494 left them. The strings must be byte-identical in both wrappers and both harnesses:
- UNTOUCHED: "once a one-shot Claude session of this task edits it" becomes "once a one-shot Claude or codex exec session of this task edits it".
- EDIT: "have a one-shot Claude session of this task re-edit the path" becomes "have a one-shot Claude or codex exec session of this task re-edit the path".
- WITNESS becomes: `Only a one-shot Claude (claude -p) or codex exec session's editing call (Claude Edit/Write, Codex apply_patch, or a Serena editor) leaves a TOOL witness; a Codex TUI, Gemini, Grok or interactive Claude session's edits, Serena's included, leave none.`
Until task-7cc959e9 lands, recordCommit.ts HELD_REMEDY_WITNESS still carries the older sentence. That window under-promises, which is safe.
4. scripts/tests/postflight.{sh,ps1}: a fake `codex` CLI, following scenario Z's pattern (named codex, --codex-exec). It prints a `codex exec --json` stream built from task-4b0609d1's captured shapes, and writes the files that stream reports. Rows run under skip-untouched, with a live peer declaring the path and the path dirty at pre-flight:
- a completed file_change of the contested own path lands, with no held= and with a Moe-Contested trailer;
- a failed file_change of it stays held as MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED_UNTOUCHED;
- a completed Serena replace_content MCP call on it lands; a failed one stays held;
- a file_change outside the repo is not harvested (WARN, nothing lands from it);
- the codex TUI path is unchanged (scenario Z stays green).
Also update the remedy expectations pinned by task-9d277494's scenario, AG and AK.
5. scripts/CLAUDE.md, Land on every exit: the TOOL tier also names codex exec stream events.

NOT in scope:
- recordCommit.ts HELD_REMEDY_*, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md and docs/MCP_SERVER.md (task-7cc959e9).
- Gemini, Grok or interactive harvest.
- Any attribution policy change.

Serialization: rerun the overlap scan at planning. task-4fdc7590 and task-16bbf8ff also wait on 9d277494 and plan the same files.

Verification: task-9d277494's snapshot gate (HEAD's scripts plus this task's files; parity-check, importee-guard and postflight on sh, PS 5.1 and PS 7), plus `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-witness.test.mjs`.
definitionOfDone: postflight.{sh,ps1}: a `codex exec` seat's completed file_change of a contested own path, dirty at pre-flight with a live peer, lands under skip-untouched, and the session-ended line carries no held=.

postflight.{sh,ps1}: a completed Serena editing MCP call witnesses its path. A failed file_change, a failed MCP call and a path outside the repo witness nothing, and the contested path stays held as MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED_UNTOUCHED.
The wrappers' UNTOUCHED, EDIT and WITNESS clauses count codex exec sessions, byte-identical in both wrappers and both harnesses, and `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh` passes.
Existing Claude-stream and codex TUI postflight scenarios, scenario Z included, stay green, and the gate passes on sh, PS 5.1 and PS 7.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: A `codex exec` seat's successful editing calls now reach the post-flight TOOL tier in both wrappers. Each wrapper gives the codex-stream helper (scripts/prompt-cache.mjs codex-stream, then prompt-cache-witness.mjs from task-4b0609d1) exactly the witness env its own Claude harvest uses. sh: the helper appends straight into $MOE_TOOL_WRITES_FILE. ps1: each launch gets a temp file, and its lines are merged into $script:MoeToolWritten after the helper exits. A contested own path that a codex exec session edited (a completed file_change, or a successful Serena editing MCP call) then lands under skip-untouched like a one-shot Claude seat's.
